concept.setting: a dwarven mountain town in snowy peaks under a cold blue sky, warm light glowing everywhere
concept.buildings: squat heavy stone houses with walls a metre thick at the base, steep dark slate roofs with huge smoking chimneys, round arched doors and windows glowing orange, bronze and gold trim on gables and doors, carved runes and knotwork, massive buttresses, timber balconies, everything broad, low and immovable
concept.landmark: an enormous carved stone gate into the mountain at the town's head, a colossal statue of a dwarf king with a hammer guarding it, the arch lit by forge glow from within, smoke vents in the cliff above
concept.street_life: open forges with glowing lava and anvils, mine carts on rails through the town, a cable gondola between peaks, ale barrels outside a tavern, hanging iron lanterns, steam vents, a brewery with copper vats
concept.greenery: dark spruce and fir heavy with snow, snowy terraces, a frozen stream under an arched stone bridge
concept.materials: stone bricks, deepslate tiles and bricks, polished blackstone, chiselled stone, copper and gold trim, spruce timber, lava behind iron bars, snow and packed ice, lanterns

factions.about: Holds of one race, the same contract as orc: one canonical palette per hold, the swaps from the authored base; the land chooses which hold settles where (styles/settlement.json). Each clan's `swaps` is its palette expanded to plain block ids for 1.21.1 (generated by src/styles/expand.mjs: read these, not the palette).
factions.base: the authored base materials (dwarf parts are built in these and nothing else for walls, roofs and trim): stone_bricks (and its stairs, slabs, walls) for walls; deepslate_tiles (and forms) for roofs; deepslate_bricks (and forms) for plinths, buttresses and battered bases; chiseled_stone_bricks for runes; spruce for timber, doors and balconies; gold_block for trim; waxed_cut_copper (and forms) for small accents; lanterns; the yard surface red_sand and dead_bush (markers the placer swaps for the land's ground and plant)

deepforge.name: Deepforge hold
deepforge.feel: the mountain hold: grey stone brick under dark slate, gold trim, forge glow; the canonical dwarf look

redcrag.name: Redcrag hold
redcrag.feel: a hold cut from red rock: brick-red roofs over brown mud-brick walls, dark oak timber

brasshammer.name: Brasshammer hold
brasshammer.feel: engineers and smiths: tuff brick walls under green weathered-copper roofs, copper for the gold trim
